info.title: Edvanz — Exams Module API
info.description:
Offline **Exams** endpoints (`/api/exams/*`) plus the exam-related extension of the attendance dashboard.

**Auth:** every endpoint requires a Teacher/Assistant Bearer JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). `teacherId` is taken from the token — never sent in the body.

**Envelope:** every response is `{ success, code, message, data }`. `code` is a stable, language-independent string you branch on; `message` is localized (Accept-Language: `en` | `ar`).

**Batch endpoints** (grades, attendance) return HTTP **200** even when some rows are invalid — check `data.allSucceeded` and each `data.items[].success` / `data.items[].code`. A concurrency conflict fails the whole batch with **409**.

**Delivery types:** `DuringSession` (exam taken inside a scheduled session occurrence — attendance is synced from that session and is **read-only** in the exam) vs `SeparateTime` (its own date — attendance is taken in the exam via `/attendance` or `/attendance/scan`).

**v1.1 additions:** send `grade: null` on `PUT /api/exams/grades` to **clear** an entered grade (the student reverts to `Attended`, attendance kept); opened-exam sessions carry **`attendanceTaken`/`gradesTaken`** (drive the *Take* vs *Edit* labels) and the exam carries **`distinctStudentCount`**; each home card carries **`totalStudents`** and **`pendingCount`**.

**v1.2 additions:** create takes `sessionIds` **or** `groupIds` (id-lists, the other null/empty) plus a single `examDate` — groups expand to their member sessions server-side. `GET /api/exams/home` is **paginated** (`upcomingPage`/`pastPage`/`pageSize`) and each card carries `selectionMode` + `assignedSessions[]` + `assignedGroups[]` (groups expanded to inner sessions). Grade/attendance write endpoints are keyed by **`teacherStudentId`** (grades also take a top-level `examId`) instead of `obligationId`; responses still include `obligationId`.

post.description: Creates an exam for **sessions OR groups** — send `sessionIds` or `groupIds` (the other null/empty); groups expand to their member sessions server-side. One occurrence is materialized per resolved session. A single `examDate` applies to the whole exam: `SeparateTime` uses it as the exam date (today or future); `DuringSession` resolves each session's scheduled class on that date (every targeted session must have a class that day). `studentIds` optionally narrows to a global subset. The selection mode (sessions vs groups) is remembered and surfaced on the home screen.

Each card also carries the parent exam's `selectionMode` and its `assignedSessions` / `assignedGroups` (each group expanded to its member sessions).

put.summary: Save a batch of distinct per-student grades
put.description: Each item targets a student by `teacherStudentId`, resolved to their single obligation within the exam given by the top-level `examId`. Each carries its own `grade` and `rowVersion` (echo the `rowVersion` you last read for that student). Valid rows are applied and returned with a **fresh** `rowVersion`; invalid rows come back with a `code`. `0 ≤ grade ≤ maxGrade`. Entering a grade marks the student `AttendedWithGrade`; send `grade: null` to **clear** an entered grade (reverts to `Attended`, attendance kept; a clear skips the range/absent/during-session guards). A during-session student not yet `Attended` cannot be graded (`AttendanceNotRecordedForExam`). Any stale `rowVersion` fails the whole batch with 409.

clearGrade.summary: Clear a grade (null) - student stays Attended

200.description: Processed. Check `allSucceeded` and each item. Failing item codes: `GradeExceedsMax`, `GradeOutOfRange`, `CannotGradeAbsentStudent`, `AttendanceNotRecordedForExam`, `ObligationNotFound` (student not in the exam), `AmbiguousStudentInExam`. A `null` grade clears the row (status → `Attended`, `grade: null`).

clearedGrade.summary: A cleared grade - status reverts to Attended, grade null

partialFailure.summary: One over the max, one student not in the exam

example.message: Please select at least one student for the bulk action

409.description: A stale rowVersion — reload and retry

example.message: This student record was updated by someone else. Please reload and try again

404.description: The exam was not found or is not yours

put.summary: Take attendance for a separate-time exam (batch present/absent)
put.description: Batch present/absent for a SEPARATE-time exam occurrence. Each item targets a student by `teacherStudentId` (resolved within `occurrenceId`). `present: true` → `Attended` (keeps an entered grade → `AttendedWithGrade`); `present: false` → `DidNotAttend` (clears any grade). **Rejected for during-session exams** with 409 `AttendanceReadOnlyForDuringSession`.

get.summary: App home dashboard (extended with exam flags)
get.description: Existing attendance dashboard, now with exam awareness — each session card carries `isExamSession` (+ `examId`/`examOccurrenceId`/`examName`) when a during-session exam falls on today's occurrence, and a new `examsToday[]` lists separate-time exams due today. Only the exam-related fields are shown below.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Defaults to the teacher's local today

examDate.description: Single exam date for the whole exam. SeparateTime: today or future. DuringSession: each session must have a class that day.

sessionIds.description: Recipient by sessions. Provide EITHER sessionIds OR groupIds.

groupIds.description: Recipient by groups; each expands to its member sessions. Provide EITHER groupIds OR sessionIds.

studentIds.description: Optional global student subset across the resolved sessions; omit = all

rowVersion.description: base64 concurrency token — echo it back when saving this row's grade

examId.description: The exam (template) these grades belong to

grade.description: 0 ≤ grade ≤ maxGrade. Send null to CLEAR the entered grade (student reverts to Attended).

rowVersion.description: base64 token from the last read of this row

occurrenceId.description: The exam occurrence id (from the exam view / home card)
